name: cursor-subscription
description: Use a Cursor subscription as a first-class ZCode provider: Cursor models appear in the model picker, with ZCode's own tools, permissions and context management.

description_i18n.en: Use a Cursor subscription as a first-class ZCode provider: Cursor models appear in the model picker, with ZCode's own tools, permissions and context management.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将 Cursor 订阅作为 ZCode 原生模型提供方：Cursor 模型直接出现在模型选择器中，沿用 ZCode 自身的工具、权限与上下文管理。

port.description: Loopback port the local shim listens on. Must match the baseUrl configured in the ZCode provider.

auto_start.description: Start the local shim automatically when the MCP server loads. Turn off if you start it yourself with scripts/shim.mjs.
